reference_sql:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
with_avg AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, spend,
         AVG(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id) AS avg_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
)
SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, spend, ROUND(avg_spend, 2) AS channel_avg
FROM with_avg
WHERE spend > avg_spend

WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
channel_avg AS (  -- one row per channel with spend
  SELECT channel_id, AVG(spend) AS avg_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT cs.campaign_id, cs.channel_id, cs.spend, ROUND(ca.avg_spend, 2) AS channel_avg
FROM campaign_spend cs
JOIN channel_avg ca ON ca.channel_id = cs.channel_id
WHERE cs.spend > ca.avg_spend

  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
x AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, spend,
         AVG(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id) AS avg_exact
